cohort: The study included 441 infants who died after being admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU), pediatric ward, and emergency department at Abuzar Hospital between 2020 and 2021.
finding: Respiratory failure was identified as the leading cause of neonatal mortality, and NICU admission and prematurity were significantly associated with higher mortality rates.
mod_finding: The rate of mortality was higher in infants born via natural birth compared to those born by cesarean sections.
